Food industries are businesses that process, preserve, package and distribute food for consumers. Examples include milling, dairy, meat, beverage, bakery and fruit-processing industries. They use raw materials such as maize, milk, fruits, vegetables and meat to produce safe and convenient food products. Food industries create employment, add value to local agricultural products and contribute to economic development.
